```yaml
name: Pages

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v4
      with:
        go-version: '1.26'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: go mod download

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        docker run --rm -v ${{ github.workspace }}:/src -w /src golang:1.26 sh -lc '
          export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin
          go test ./server/data/s3
          go test ./server/server -run TestNewDataBackend -count=1
        '

    - name: Build documentation
      run: make docs

    - name: Check documentation
      run: |
        git diff --exit-code
```
